faqs.question: Do you remove bees humanely in Maplewood?
faqs.answer: Yes, we prioritize humane bee removal and relocation whenever possible. faqs.question: What types of bees do you remove in Maplewood?
faqs.answer: We remove all types of bees common to the Maplewood area, including honeybees, carpenter bees, bumblebees, and yellow jackets.
